import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    q = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    pref = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        pref[i] = pref[i - 1] ^ arr[i - 1]
    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        u = int(next(it))
        v = int(next(it))
        out.append(str(pref[v] ^ pref[u - 1]))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
